gate.rescaling: neighbourhood mean matched to the raw score's standard deviation
gate.selected_on: cluster-disjoint half of the training fold

fitting: cell contents are counts; the integer fan-out is one ridge-regularised closed-form solve over the table outputs on the training fold, rounded to integers; no gradient, no iteration, no test-fold selection
what_is_different_from_geometry_field: appends 144 nonlocal-seam / packing-frustration columns (48 quantities x 3 aggregations) under union with the 645+624 geometry_field columns; same table topology
